verdict.rationale: Loops documents event-triggered workflows, which start when an event is sent, and campaigns that send to a segment one time. Nothing in the evidence shows a recurring or time-based schedule for jobs or workflows, so one-off and event-triggered actions do not count as recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Send events to start published workflows.
